puzzleText:
The details of your next mission are in a PDF file on the phone.

Just one problem - the PDF file is password-protected.

Suddenly, the phone vibrates - DING!
  - you've received a text message.

And then another one - DING!
  - a second text message.

You realize that combining these messages somehow will give you the password you need.

Can you work out what the password is?

#### **Message 1** ####
	1804
	ADJS


#### **Message 2** ####
	27365
	MNEOB
title: For Your Eyes Only
